title: Vikunja from 0.20.5 before 2.8.0 contains a login cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the OpenID Connect…
description: Vikunja versions from 0.20.5 up to but not including 2.8.0 contain a login cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in the OpenID Connect callback handler. This flaw allows attackers to craft a callback link with an empty state parameter and their own authorization code, causing victims to be silently logged into the attacker's account and potentially exposing their entered data.
